title: Partners - Basuka Energy
metaDescription: Partner with Ba-Suka Energy to build Africa's clean-energy infrastructure. Three partnership pillars: EV manufacturers, climate funds, and technology providers. September 2026 launch in Ouagadougou.

sections.heading: Build Africa's clean-energy infrastructure with us
sections.body: We are selecting strategic partners for our September 2026 launch – EV manufacturers, infrastructure funds, and technology providers who went to co- build the Sahel’s first professional smart battery-swap network.

sections.heading: Where we need your expertise
sections.intro: Our partnership model is built around three strategic pillars. Each offers a distinct integration pathway into Burkina Faso’s first loT-enabled, solar-powered energy infrastructure network.

items.title: EV MANUFACTURERS
items.subtitle: OEM battery interoperability.
items.body: We partner with 2-wheel and 3- wheel vehicle manufacturers to integrate SRA” battery standards directly into new frames – ensuring high-performance mobility optimised for the Sahel environment.
bullets: Co-engincering for Sahel hoat & dust tolerance
Access to Ba-Suka’s growing ridor network
Joint route-to-market for Burking Faso & beyond

items.title: CLIMATE FUND
items.subtitle: Infrastructure & ESGinvestment
items.body: We provide a high-impact platform for infrastructure and climate investors – offering transparent, loT-driven data for ESG compliance and measurable carbon avoidance through our solar-pawered network.
bullets: Real-time lol impact metrics from day one

items.title: TECHNOLGY PROVIDER
items.subtitle: Solar, BMS & loT solutions
items.body: We seek partners in high-efficiency PV systems, advanced battery management technology. and loT networking to keep our smart electricity network operating at 99%+ uptime across West Africa.
bullets: High-efficiency PV pancis for extreme heat
Advanced EMS for multi-use battery cycles
IOT networking for remote station monitoring

sections.heading: Four reasons to join now
sections.intro: Ba-Suka is not a concept – it is a fully engineered infrastructure platform targeting its September 2026 pilot launch in Ouagadougou.

items.title: First-mover advantage
items.body: Ba-Suka is building the first professional smart battery-swap network in Burkina Faso. Partners secure preferential integration terms and first-to-market positioning in a rapidly growing EV market.

items.title: Professional Yennenga operations
items.body: Every station is managed by a certified Yennenga Warrior – a woman trained at the Ba-Suka Academy. This drives deep community trust, elite service standards, and an 80%+ staff retention target.

items.title: Grid-independent reliability
items.body: 100% solar-powered Swap & Glow™ stations operate entirely off-grid – meaning our network stays live even during Burkina Faso’s frequent national grid failures. 99%+ uptime target from day one.

items.title: Multi-use SIRA™ ecosystem
items.body: One SIRA™ battery powers electric motorcycles, commercial kiosks, and household appliances. This maximises utilisation per battery unit – increasing revenue potential and broadening your addressable market.

sections.heading: How SIRAT™ integration works
sections.intro: For vehicle manufacturers, integration with the SIRA™ network is engineered to be as frictionless as possible – from BMS protocol alignment to customer access.

items.title: SIRA™ interoperability
items.body: Our engineering team works directly with your R&D team to align loT-optimised battery dimensions and BMS protocols with your 2-wheel and 3-wheel frames.

items.title: Swap & Glow™ access
items.body: Your customers get immediate access to the growing network of solar-powered stations, each managed by a certified Yennenga Warrior for elite, consistent service.

items.title: Operational uptime data
items.body: We provide live data redundancy and 99%+ uptime metrics that give your customers the confidence to make the switch from fossil-fuel vehicles to electric.

sections.heading: How to become a Basuka Partner
sections.intro: We move quickly. From initial enquiry to signed partnership agreement, our process is designed to get strategic partners integrated before the September 2026 launch window.

items.title: Initial enquiry
items.body: Email info@basukaenergy.com with your organisation name, partnership type (OEM / Fund / Technology), and a brief summary of what you bring to the network.

items.title: Pitch deck & technical brief
items.body: We share Ba-Suka’s full investor/partner pitch deck and the SIRA™ technical integration brief relevant to your partnership pillar.

items.title: Discovery call
items.body: A focused 45-minute call with Ba-Suka’s founding team to align on integration scope, commercial terms, and launch timeline fit

items.title: Partnership agreement
items.body: We move to a formal partnership agreement with clear deliverables, milestones, and revenue-sharing or investment terms anchored to the September 2026 launch.fit

sections.eyebrow: READY TO BUILD THE FUTURE OF AFRICAN ENERGY?
sections.heading: We are selecting partners for our September 2026 launch
sections.body: Ba-Suka Energy is opening its SIRA™ network to a focused group of strategic partners. Spots are limited ahead of the pilot launch. Reach out today to begin the conversation.
